mediaDetails.ext_alt_text: A comparison of two actual archived patterns. Left: dodecahedra in a dodecahedron at counts 29–33 all have certified edge 3.7470909531576, while occupied volume rises through 55.1%, 57.0%, 58.9%, 60.8%, 62.7%. Right: six octahedra in an octahedron have certified edge 2.0000003674235; seven have 2.5000004286608. The edge rises 25.0% and container volume 95.3%, while occupied volume falls from 75.0% to 44.8%. Values are feasible construction upper bounds and their structural measurements, not proved global optima.
